scope: Star Atlas redesign of all six pages and its review/upload package. Guide wording unchanged. No application build changes.

browser.surface: Local static preview (python http.server) in headless Microsoft Edge, plus the Claude desktop app's browser pane

measurement.tool: tasteskill v2 inspect.mjs at 1440, 768 and 390 px; palette-cream allowed because cream is the brand's own star colour

results.index.html: 0 FAIL; WARN card-rows (dealt word-tile and FAQ card layouts), no-footage
results.getting-started.html: 0 FAIL; WARN card-rows, no-footage, 35px margin difference at 768 px
results.memory-control.html: 0 FAIL; WARN no-footage, 768/390 margin difference, a tall SVG diagram counted as blank at 390 px

measurement.source_lint: tasteskill lint.mjs: 0 FAIL; WARN for an em-dash count and the word 'unlock' in existing guide copy
measurement.design_detector: Impeccable detect: placeholder contrast, empty viewer image and tight leading fixed; remaining findings are existing guide copy or padding expressed through CSS variables

interactions: Homepage model switcher changes only the model name and destination line; all four saved records stay
Download picker updates the requirement line for each model
Conversation, Library and Map tabs swap the screenshot and its full-size link
FAQ keeps one card open at a time
Bug-report form builds a pre-filled GitHub issue URL (window.open intercepted; nothing was posted)
Screenshot viewer opens full-size images on the homepage and the guides
Guide contents marker follows the reading position and returns to the first section at the top
Getting started connection tabs show one panel at a time
Map demo renders its interactive map; each rendered part is marked as product interface (data-ui)
limits: Full-page review captures stop at 16,000 px, so the bottoms of the longest phone-width guides were reviewed through the inspector's screen-by-screen photographs instead
Not tested on real phones, Safari or Firefox; opening from the file system was checked in Edge only
The live GitHub Pages site was not changed or tested

package.scope: Complete static upload package; no Git history, old archives, design-tool working files or the retired brand banner.
